output.rationale: The requirement specifies the manufacture of metal-clad switchgear for continuous service at the specified location. Among the candidates, 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an engineered-to-order (ETO) product that provides arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, which aligns with the requirement. This choice is based on the product's description and its relevance to the specification.
